summary: Uninstall automation dashboard and its PostgreSQL container with the ansible.containerized_installer.dashboard_uninstall playbook; this permanently deletes all metrics, saved reports and the database.
questions: How do I uninstall automation dashboard?
Does uninstalling automation dashboard delete my reports?

answer_card.title: Uninstall automation dashboard
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible-playbook -i inventory ansible.containerized_installer.dashboard_uninstall
```
**Warning:** this permanently deletes all collected metrics, saved reports and the PostgreSQL database.
